howToMeasure: Chest: Wrap the tape measure around your torso. Go underneath your arms, across your shoulder blades, and over the largest part of your chest. The chest measurement is usually the size of the coat. For a more relaxed fit, add 1 inch to the total measurement.

Over Arm: If your over arm measurement is more than 7 inches larger than your chest measurement, the over arm measurement trumps the chest measurement. In this case, your suit size needs to match your over arm measurement.
Waist: Measure around your natural waistline, keeping the tape snug but not tight. This is typically just above the navel.
Hips: Measure around the fullest part of your hips, keeping the tape parallel to the floor.
Inseam: Measure from the inside of your thigh (crotch seam) down to the bottom of your ankle bone.

description: Description This mysterious, dazzling ring comes to you from the Engelbert Absolutely Knot line of jewellery. Crafted in 18 karat whitegold with pavé-set brilliant cut black diamonds with the total weight of 5.60 carats, this stunning piece features the gloriously designed Absolute Knot. 18k whitegold ring 5.60ct. TW brilliant cut black diamonds Ring sizes: 50-59 Colour: Whitegold, black Fit & Size: Choose 2 sizes smaller than your normal size What's the story Engelbert Stockholm is an award-winning brand of jewellery and a well-respected name with a fine heritage of over a hundred years. Founded by Heribert Engelbert in 1920, the brand has been nurtured by generations as a family business and continues to uphold its traditional cultural values. At the same time, it keeps up with the times with exclusive and contemporary designs aimed at pleasing the modern woman who values beauty and quality in all she chooses. Engelbert’s chief designer is Thomas Carlsson who has extensive experience in jewellery design. He has been the force behind the brand’s well-loved collections for over thirty years. Every piece of Engelbert jewellery is crafted by expert goldsmiths and gem setters with extensive training and experience. Every piece is underscored by the design aesthetic and high manufacturing standards that are typical of Swedish art jewellery and distinct Scandinavian tradition. What's great about it As is typical of Engelbert Stockholm jewellery, this captivating Absolutely Fat Knot Ring is a distinctive reminder of your commitment to something you hold precious, a reminder that stands out for its bold design and fine craftsmanship. Fashioned in 18 karat whitegold which is expressively combined with an array of black diamonds, it features the signature knot that is central to the Absolutely Knot Collection. A knot symbolises a promise and has been a common motif in jewellery through the ages. It signifies a bond and stands as a metaphor for commitment and love. The large and sparkling black knot in this whitegold ring is opulent, bold, and trendy. The stylish and confident statement it makes is highlighted by the dazzling diamonds. This piece of jewellery is sure to attract a modern, independent, and confident woman of discerning taste who prefers to accentuate her style with bold and eye-catching details. How to wear it The contemporary design of this luxurious Absolutely Fat Knot Ring is inspired by classic traditions. The stylish statement it makes, however, creates a stronger bond with a woman’s character than with her outfit. Therefore, it can be worn with various kinds of apparel, at various occasions. This audacious creation will add a captivating accent to your classic business suit or casual dress, while it lends an extravagant flair to your night out. Its classic combination of black and white will match well with diverse colours, making each outfit look special. For added style and sparkle, try this incredible ring with other rings and bracelets from the Absolutely Knot line of jewellery. Combine it with the yellow and/or rose gold pieces for an ultra-modern, two- or even three-tone look. Why we love it We admire the winning collection of beautiful jewellery by Engelbert Stockholm, which emphatically spells exquisite design, flawless finish, refined taste, and class. Every piece in this line is thoughtfully designed and expertly fashioned to adorn your wrists and fingers. At The Jewellery Room, we are particularly impressed by Engelbert Stockholm’s exclusive treasures with historical soul. Jewellery by Engelbert Stockholm is marked by a fine balance between expert artisanship and contemporary design, rooted in a grand 100-year-old tradition. The Engelbert Absolutely Fat Knot Ring in whitegold set with black brilliant cut diamonds is a perfect example of the bold modern style inspired by classic traditions that is bound to appeal to contemporary independent woman who keeps her promises and sparkles with confidence.
